﻿. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..\..\Projects\Tooling\primitives\show-invocation-table.ps1')

# Example inputs
$argsHash = [ordered]@{
    InputPath = 'C:\Projects\Example\input'
    OutputPath = 'C:\Projects\Example\out'
    ConfigPath = 'C:\Projects\Example\config.yaml'
    Mode = 'Full'
    Projects = 'Universe,Local'
    Relative = $true
    Long = ('x' * 200)
}

Write-Host "-- Table Output --" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Show-InvocationTable -InvocationArgs $argsHash -Title 'Invocation (table)' -Width 100 -Format table

Write-Host "`n-- JSON Output --" -ForegroundColor Cyan
$json = Show-InvocationTable -InvocationArgs $argsHash -Title 'Invocation (json)' -Format json
Write-Host $json
